title: Would not work on stove, more of a novelty items
text:
Would not work on stove, more of a novelty items. [[VIDEOID:721ad50da3e048779da7a7cca1815c66]] This would only spin on my very hot wood burner. And it barely moves any air. What a shame!!! I wanted this to work so much! Not worth the asking price.
